feature_name: Dopamine Depot /shop go-live — Printful catalog + Stripe Payment Link checkout
owner: Jess (executed by Claude with Jess's explicit approval in-session)
scope_summary: Activates the static /shop catalog as the single merch surface. At Netlify build time, scripts/fetch-printful-products.mjs pulls the 14 live sync products from Printful store 18311430 (fix: script now sends X-PF-Store-Id for account-level tokens). Nav 'Dopamine Depot' now points to /shop/; legacy pages dopamine-depot.html, store.html, /store 301-redirect to /shop/ (old pages referenced a dead Printful store 17829329 and placeholder href='#' buy buttons). Checkout is off-site Stripe Payment Links at a flat $29.99/tee + $4.99 US shipping, size selected via dropdown at checkout; links land in shop/checkout-links.json in a follow-up commit (until then the shop shows the designed email-to-order fallback). Fulfillment is manual for V1: Stripe order email -> place order in Printful. Jess approved: ship all 14 products, $29.99 pricing, Stripe link creation.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: No on-site payment processing or PII storage; payment and shipping data are collected by Stripe on Stripe-hosted pages. Dropship fulfillment by Printful, unchanged model. HUMAN VERIFY: sales tax collection settings in Stripe once revenue starts, and a posted return/refund policy page.
evidence: Site remains static with no forms collecting PII
Printful is merchant of record for production/shipping only; Stripe account belongs to Jess

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Static pages, no new trackers, no cookies added. products.json is generated at build time server-side; the browser only fetches a static JSON.
evidence: No localStorage/session data introduced by shop pages

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: Merch only. Identity-affirming humor, no clinical or treatment claims.
evidence: Product names/descriptions reviewed during catalog audit

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: No urgency mechanics, no countdown clocks, no scarcity messaging. Flat pricing, visible before checkout.
evidence: Shop copy: 'no countdown-clock nonsense' honored in implementation

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Low-stim static grid, one canonical shop surface instead of three competing pages, reducing navigation confusion.

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Users can actually buy products that were previously placeholder links; revenue funds the app build as stated on-page.
evidence: 14 real products with real mockups replace href='#' placeholders

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Shop copy already matches brand voice. 'Ships worldwide' claim on legacy page is retired with the redirect; Stripe links currently allow US shipping only. HUMAN VERIFY: revisit international shipping claim before enabling non-US countries.
evidence: Legacy page with 'Ships worldwide' now 301s to /shop/

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Shop pages were built with semantic HTML and keyboard-usable controls; no changes to that in this gate. Checkout accessibility is Stripe-hosted (WCAG-maintained by Stripe).
evidence: No markup changes to shop pages in this commit beyond none

security_and_reliability.rationale: PRINTFUL_API_TOKEN lives only in Netlify env vars, not the repo. Build script fails soft: token/API problems write an empty catalog and never break the site deploy.
evidence: fetch script emptyCatalog() failure mode verified locally with real token: 14 products written

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Transparent flat pricing ($29.99 + $4.99 US shipping shown by Stripe before payment). No upsells, no subscriptions, no pre-checked boxes.
evidence: Payment links configured with fixed price and visible shipping rate

ship_decision.conditions: Jess approved scope, pricing, and Stripe usage in-session on 2026-07-03. Update same day: all 14 Stripe Payment Links created (live mode, $29.99 + $4.99 US shipping, size dropdown S-3XL) and wired into shop/checkout-links.json — checkout is live. Remaining follow-ups: (1) sales tax + refund policy review before scale, (2) V2 webhook auto-fulfillment (manual Printful order placement until then). Same-day patch: shop image surfaces switched to white so transparent print files with dark ink (Chaos Clocking) are visible — accessibility/visibility fix, no behavior change. Same-day patch 2: added assets/brand/merch-tags/ (constellation + Divergify outside-label art, navy + cream variants) hosted on-domain so Printful can fetch them; Jess approved switching garment branding from back print to outside label (cheaper per unit, matches original brand intent).
